summary.description: Plain-text one-paragraph summary of what was done. Bodies of artifacts are NOT inlined here.

outputs.description: Map of declared output name -> absolute file path. Never inline content.

escalations.description: Decisions that need a human but never block the run: one entry per escalated item.

signals.description: Booleans/counters the orchestrator branches on at runtime (e.g. has_blocking_findings). A reviewer stage whose downstream correction loop reads `stages.<this>.outputs.<name>.<prop>` MUST mirror that boolean here as `signals.<prop>` — the emitted Workflow reads `signals`, not the artifact file.

follow_ups.description: Optional follow-up tasks discovered during the stage. Surfaced to orchestrator, not blocking.

ask_user_questions.description: Audit trail of AskUserQuestion calls the sub-agent already issued. Each item logs question id and the user's answer. Orchestrator does NOT re-ask.

scope_violations.description: Files the sub-agent attempted to write outside scope and were blocked by the hook.

skills_loaded.description: Proof of skill loading. Required (by the emitted Workflow's per-dispatch schema) for every stage declaring skills: one entry per declared skill, naming one rule of it applied in the stage. A reply missing a declared skill fails the stage; only a read-only role (analyzer, planner, reviewer) is first re-dispatched once with a reminder.

assumptions.description: Choices taken in place of a question during an autonomous run.

tokens_used.description: Total tokens (input + output) consumed by the sub-agent.
